_about: Held-out routing eval for the showcase's Ask DeepGrid. Written on 18 Sep 2026 BEFORE app/data/theme-examples.ts; never copy these questions into that file. `expect` is a theme title the question must reach, null for an on-topic question that must NOT be forced into a curated theme, or "none" for an off-topic question that must get no grounded answer. npm run build:semantic picks the theme thresholds (most correct, zero wrong, zero forced) and the relevance floor (catches the most off-topic questions without dropping any on-topic one) from this set, and fails if the recall floor cannot be met.

_minRecall: 0.5, not the DG32 site's 0.7: there a miss falls back to generic text, here it falls back to the best-grounded passages. Measured 18 Sep 2026 (bge-small, examples written blind): 9/18 reach their theme, 0 wrong, 0/8 forced; of the 9 misses, 6 fall back to a passage from the expected theme's own section or slide (e.g. 'contradict each other' -> 'Ten things to test'). The floor guards against a regression below that, not a target to tune the example questions toward.
